_about: How much MapleSyrup speaks up on its own, and when. The levels are the player's dial (quiet, normal, talkative); the rest is the director's pacing. Inner Thoughts (CHI 2025): the moderately proactive setting won with players, the quiet one was rated worst, the chatty one ignored natural pauses. The thresholds are on a 1–5 scale of how much a thought wants to be said; the gaps are seconds.
